description: Imports a video from a public link, or every video in a shared Google Drive folder, into the team's uploads, where Hyperhuman splits it into exercise clips. Use when the user wants to add exercise videos from a link, Dropbox, Google Drive or a folder of recordings. Not for AI-generated clips (use generate_video_clip). Returns the upload ID and name, or the folder import message. Imported video counts toward the account's video storage minutes; clips appear in list_uploads_to_review when ready.

expected_exercises.description: Exercise names in the order they appear, with url only, to guide AI clip naming, e.g. ["Squat", "Lunge"]. Up to 60.

gdrive_folder_url.description: Shared Google Drive folder link; every video in it is imported, e.g. "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c". Use instead of url.

kind.description: What the video is, with url only: multi_exercise = several exercises to split into clips; class = a full class; promo = a promo video; educational = a talk or tutorial. The backend defaults to multi_exercise.

name.description: Name for the upload, with url only, e.g. "Lower body session". Omit to use the file name.

url.description: Public link to one video file (MP4, MOV and similar, up to 2 GB), e.g. a Dropbox or Google Drive file share link. YouTube, Vimeo pages and streaming playlists are not supported. Use instead of gdrive_folder_url.
